title: Several per view, with a header
description: perView shows three cards with the fourth peeking. title puts a heading and the previous and next buttons in a header; the dots sit under the slides. Each slide is a Card from its image, alt, title and description.

title: Custom slides and autoplay
description: Render each slide yourself with the slide render content. Without a title the buttons overlay the slides. autoplay always shows a pause button, pauses on hover and focus, and starts paused under reduced motion.
